text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Perfectly straight today, too. In 
a single line. Anywhere that isn't white 
is—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
That's a rare curved feature on you, Light 
O, considering you live for the straight 
line. Is there any special meaning behind 
that blaze?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: No. Though, it brings back memories.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I combed it, my blaze 
just wouldn't straighten out. To me as I 
cried, my father said—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"That blaze makes you instantly 
recognizable, no matter where you're 
running from. Daddy loves it," he told me—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... So even for a devout believer in 
straight lines like you, that curve is the 
one exception you'll allow...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: No, I haven't forgiven you at all.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I love my dad. But I can't forgive curves! 
I want to make them straight! No, I WILL 
make them straight!!!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That is the memory of what I swore in my 
heart— Prepare yourself, because one day I 
will definitely set it straight!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It really is a straight line as far as the 
eye can see, isn't it...?
